'''Arrin Nikols''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]] along with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Blanca Nikols|Blanca]] and his son [[Ritte Nikols|Ritte]]. Arrin was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the the [[InterStellar Regulators]], who had been bribed by the Hutts to help them [[Conquest of Makeb|conquer]] Makeb in [[3638 BBY]]. As the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' mining operations soon caused the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to start tearing itself apart, Arrin quit the Regulators and in desperation his forces attacked a number of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] evac camps and took civilians hostage in order to secure passage aboard [[the Ark]] that was being prepared to evacuate Makeb's civilians. Arrin was defeated by Republic forces, but his wife intervened and convinced the Republic forces to permit Arrin to live. Accepting that he would face jailtime for his actions, Arrin stood down and accompanied his son and wife to the Ark.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Nikols appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, released on [[April 9]], [[2013]]. If the player chooses a Dark Side option, they kill Nikols instead.
